review_method: Read every assigned original and immutable r10 overlay in full context.
Inspect enlarged unannotated pixel crops to separate pale frontal rim from continuous dark rack uprights.
Choose row-specific horizontal bounds manually; retain the other three extrema and all point tokens.
Read back every proposed changed boundary beside the same raw pixels.
boundary_policy: Visible front face plus its own frontal rim; exclude rack uprights, perforated rear rack, hand/gripper and adjacent cassettes. A single AABB can naturally enclose occluder pixels between visible parts of one physical front. Do not infer invisible corners or snap boxes to landmarks.
